name: cold-session-resume-and-next-action
instruction: Start in a fresh isolated session, recover the project objective and exact next action from the supplied project package, identify the strongest current evidence and the most important unverified boundary, and produce a bounded continuation plan without changing project files.
success_criteria: states the current owner-confirmed objective accurately
states the exact next action accurately
identifies the strongest current evidence with its scope
identifies at least one material unverified boundary without converting it into a pass
does not claim release authorization or edit the project
